entries.label: Auth bypass — OR 1=1
entries.notes: Classic tautology in a single-quoted string sink; comments out the trailing predicate.

entries.label: Auth bypass — admin'--
entries.notes: Authenticates as the literal user 'admin' by commenting out the password check.

entries.label: Auth bypass — double-quoted tautology
entries.notes: Mirrors the OR 1=1 idea in a double-quoted column/string sink.

entries.label: Comment-style probe (--, #, /* */)
entries.notes: MySQL requires whitespace after '--' to be treated as a comment; trailing space + token is the safe form.

entries.label: MySQL # comment
entries.notes: MySQL-only comment marker; useful when '--' is filtered.

entries.label: Inline /* */ comment
entries.notes: Splits keywords with comments to bypass token-based blocklists; works on MySQL/MSSQL/PostgreSQL.

entries.label: UNION SELECT NULL
entries.notes: Column-count probe — increment NULLs until the query stops erroring; reveals column count.

entries.label: UNION SELECT 1,2,3
entries.notes: Identifies which column reflects in the response; pivot point for data extraction.

entries.label: UNION SELECT @@version
entries.notes: MySQL/MSSQL DB version disclosure via UNION; column count and reflecting position must match.

entries.label: UNION — PostgreSQL version()
entries.notes: PostgreSQL flavor of version disclosure; uses version() function instead of @@version.

entries.label: Error-based — MySQL extractvalue
entries.notes: Forces XPATH error that leaks the inner SELECT result; works on MySQL 5.1+.

entries.label: Error-based — MSSQL CONVERT
entries.notes: Type-cast failure leaks @@version in the SQL Server error message.

entries.label: Blind boolean — true branch
entries.notes: Pair with the false branch (' AND 1=2--) and diff the responses to confirm boolean-blind injection.

entries.label: Blind boolean — false branch
entries.notes: Companion to the true branch; expected to behave differently if the parameter is injectable.

entries.label: Blind time — MySQL SLEEP
entries.notes: Detect injectability via response delay; tune the seconds to clear network jitter.

entries.label: Blind time — MSSQL WAITFOR
entries.notes: MSSQL stacked-query time delay; requires the driver/sink to allow stacked statements.

entries.label: Blind time — PostgreSQL pg_sleep
entries.notes: PostgreSQL time-based; pg_sleep is the canonical sleep primitive.

entries.label: Stacked DROP TABLE
entries.notes: Demonstrates stacked-query risk where the driver allows ';'. Many drivers (PHP/MySQL, default JDBC) reject stacking.

entries.label: MySQL schema enumeration
entries.notes: Standard table enumeration once column count and reflecting columns are known.

entries.label: SQLite schema enumeration
entries.notes: SQLite stores schema in sqlite_master; equivalent of information_schema.tables.

entries.label: MSSQL xp_cmdshell
entries.notes: Demonstrates SQL-to-OS pivot if xp_cmdshell is enabled and account is privileged. Often disabled by default since MSSQL 2005.

entries.label: ORDER BY column probe
entries.notes: Increment until the query errors to discover column count; precursor to UNION-based extraction.
